title: UnoRebuilt
description: Have you ever wanted to play UNO in Minecraft? With this plugin, you can!
body:
Have you ever wanted to play UNO in Minecraft? Well, with this Plugin, you can!

Simply craft a UNO deck out of cobbled Deepslate, nether wart blocks, and a hay bale like this:

![UNO deck crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0d89eee62cab96dc7f9fa2db3dbe3112108ae30.png)

Then place it wherever you want and right-click it!

For the best experience I recommend also installing the [resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/unorebuiltresourcepack), although the plugin works okay without it.
